description: Northwind proposes splitting the monolithic order platform into bounded contexts with asynchronous integration. Review service boundaries, data ownership, deployment topology on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and failure isolation before funding the program.
constraints: No dual-writes across old and new stores after cutover window
API compatibility for mobile clients for two major versions
requiredCapabilities: Azure Service Bus or Event Hubs
Azure SQL or Cosmos DB (per service decision)
assumptions: Strangler fig pattern for first two domains
topologyHints: Prefer event-driven integration between order and inventory contexts
